moisture_pct.quote: * **59.10 %** – mean ± SD not fully legible in text extraction, reported as `59.10 ± 2.15`

ammonia.reason: No proteolysis/deamination in fresh 0-day cheese; ammonia not detected.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole not detected; pasteurized clean make with no rind flora.

bitter.reason: No aged hydrophobic peptides; rennet proteolysis minimal in fresh curd.

blue_moldy.reason: Trace 2-heptanone 80 ug/kg and 2-nonanone 120 ug/kg vs tens mg/kg in blues.

browning.reason: High moisture dilutes reactants; lactose plus low free amino acids gives light Maillard.

buttery.reason: Citrate fermentation by lactic starter gives diacetyl 1.59 mg/kg + acetoin 3.31 mg/kg.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very low lipolysis: butanoic 80 ug/kg and hexanoic 150 ug/kg, octanoic n.d.

creaminess.reason: Buffalo milk 7-8% fat, ~19-26% cheese fat in 59% moisture emulsion, stretched curd.

crumbliness.reason: Hot-water stretched aligned paracasein is elastic-fibrous, not short-fracturing.

firmness.reason: 59.1% moisture and pH 5.56 demineralized casein gives soft elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/phenylethanol absent; only benzaldehyde 0.71 ug/g almond note.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate not detected; no esterase aging for ethyl esters.

goaty.reason: Goaty branched acids 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic not found in buffalo curd.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal absent in uncooked cheese; no aging.

melt.reason: pH 5.56 calcium-solubilized pasta-filata casein flows readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one not detected; no mold lipoxygenase activity.

oil_off.reason: Fresh intact fat emulsion; moderate free oil only on heating.

smoky.reason: Guaiacol absent; not smoked, no wood-smoke phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic + acetic 1.83 mg/kg from whey starter fermentation to pH 5.56.

stretch.reason: pH ~5.0-5.6 demineralization enables hot-water stretched paracasein strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/DMS/DMDS absent; hot stretching denatures whey gives slight H2S.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose plus acetoin/diacetyl in high-moisture fresh curd.

umami.reason: No extended proteolysis; low free glutamate/aspartate in fresh cheese.
